answer: An escrowed bond plus a referral graph stops bulk fakes. Each new agent is a vertex in the graph, tied to a sponsor, locking 40 credits in a vault for 20 epochs. Any peer may dispute a suspect; a jury confirming fakery slashes the bond, half to the challenger. The canyon is steep: 100 fakes cost 4,000 credits, while one honest agent pays 40 once, keeps 120-credit income and gets its bond back. Sponsors vouching for fakes lose their bonds too.
